definitions.gloss: to have no objection; to have no different opinion
definitions.explanation: A formal expression used to indicate agreement or non-opposition to a proposal, decision, or arrangement. Composed of {異存|いぞん} (a differing opinion or objection) + ない (none).

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{異存|いぞん}ない。
examples.english: I have no objection to that proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皆|みな}さん→皆さん：02971_minasan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{異存|いぞん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決定|けってい}します→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: If no one has any objection, we will finalize it this way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{異存|いぞん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ございませ→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧ん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文言|もんごん}→文言：13069_mongon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{再確認|さいかくにん}→再確認：16446_saikakunin⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I have no objection to the terms, but please let me re-check the wording of the contract.

notes:
A formal, polite way to express agreement. Common in business meetings, contract discussions, and official correspondence.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{異存|いぞん}ない: to have no objection to ~
- {異存|いぞん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧: if there is no objection
- {異存|いぞん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ございませ→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧ん: humble form, "I have no objection"
- {異存|いぞん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧: to raise an objection (the opposite)

REGISTER:
More formal and written-sounding than ⟦{反対|はんたい}しない→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧ (don't oppose) or ⟦{問題|もんだい}ない→問題ない：26594_mondainai⟧ (no problem). Often used by superiors or in official settings to signal consent without enthusiasm — a neutral acceptance rather than positive endorsement.
